      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.* FROM a p JOIN a arguments ON arguments.__path=p.__path AND arguments.id=p.parent AND arguments.kind='arguments' JOIN functions f ON f.__path=arguments.__path AND f.id=arguments.parent WHERE p.kind='arg'

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind='ClassDef'

stages.name: local_names
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,id,suffix) AS (SELECT __path,id,id,'' FROM a WHERE kind IN ('Name','Attribute','Call') UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.root,child.id,CASE WHEN parent.kind='Attribute' THEN '.'||parent.name||w.suffix ELSE w.suffix END FROM walk w JOIN a parent ON parent.__path=w.__path AND parent.id=w.id JOIN a child ON child.__path=parent.__path AND child.parent=parent.id WHERE parent.kind='Attribute' AND child.field='value' OR parent.kind='Call' AND child.field='func') SELECT w.__path,w.root id,CASE WHEN n.kind='Name' THEN n.name||w.suffix ELSE nullif(substr(w.suffix,2),'') END name FROM walk w JOIN a n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.id WHERE n.kind='Name' OR (n.kind NOT IN ('Name','Attribute','Call'))

stages.name: context_names
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,id,suffix) AS (SELECT __path,id,id,'' FROM a WHERE kind IN ('Name','Attribute','Call') UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.root,child.id,CASE WHEN parent.kind='Attribute' THEN '.'||parent.name||w.suffix ELSE w.suffix END FROM walk w JOIN a parent ON parent.__path=w.__path AND parent.id=w.id JOIN a child ON child.__path=parent.__path AND child.parent=parent.id WHERE parent.kind='Attribute' AND child.field='value') SELECT w.__path,w.root id,CASE WHEN n.kind='Name' THEN n.name||w.suffix ELSE nullif(substr(w.suffix,2),'') END name FROM walk w JOIN a n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.id WHERE n.kind='Name' OR (n.kind NOT IN ('Name','Attribute'))

stages.name: shared_aliases
stages.query: SELECT alias.__path,alias.id,CASE WHEN alias.alias!='' THEN alias.alias WHEN owner.kind='Import' THEN rx_extract(alias.name,'^([^.]+)',1) ELSE alias.name END local,CASE WHEN owner.kind='ImportFrom' THEN owner.module||'.'||alias.name ELSE alias.name END origin FROM a alias JOIN a owner ON owner.__path=alias.__path AND owner.id=alias.parent WHERE alias.kind='alias' AND (owner.kind='Import' OR owner.kind='ImportFrom' AND owner.module!='')

stages.name: class_events
stages.query: SELECT c.*,replace(coalesce(rx_extract(c.__path,'(?:^|/)((?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/.*)\.py$',1),rx_extract(c.__path,'(?:^|/)([^/]+)\.py$',1)),'/','.')||'.'||c.name qualified_name FROM classes c

stages.name: shared_classes
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM class_events n WHERE n.id=(SELECT max(last.id) FROM class_events last WHERE last.__path=n.__path AND last.name=n.name)

stages.name: method_events
stages.query: SELECT f.*,owner.name class_name,(SELECT max(c.id) FROM class_events c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.name=owner.name AND c.id<f.id) class_event FROM functions f JOIN classes owner ON owner.__path=f.__path AND owner.id=f.cls

stages.name: shared_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.*,c.qualified_name FROM method_events m JOIN shared_classes c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id=m.class_event WHERE m.id=(SELECT max(last.id) FROM method_events last WHERE last.__path=m.__path AND last.class_event=m.class_event AND last.name=m.name)

stages.name: shared_functions
stages.query: SELECT f.*,replace(coalesce(rx_extract(f.__path,'(?:^|/)((?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/.*)\.py$',1),rx_extract(f.__path,'(?:^|/)([^/]+)\.py$',1)),'/','.')||'.'||f.name qualified_name FROM functions f WHERE f.cls IS NULL AND f.id=(SELECT max(last.id) FROM functions last WHERE last.__path=f.__path AND last.cls IS NULL AND last.name=f.name)

stages.name: resolved_bases
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id,coalesce((SELECT alias.origin FROM shared_aliases alias WHERE alias.__path=c.__path AND alias.local=rx_extract(q.name,'^([^.]+)',1) AND alias.id<c.id ORDER BY alias.id DESC LIMIT 1),rx_extract(q.name,'^([^.]+)',1))||coalesce(rx_extract(q.name,'^[^.]+([.].*)$',1),'') base FROM shared_classes c JOIN a b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.parent=c.id AND b.field='bases' JOIN local_names q ON q.__path=b.__path AND q.id=b.id

stages.name: derived_conditionals
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE derived(name) AS (SELECT 'l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' UNION SELECT c.qualified_name FROM derived d JOIN resolved_bases b ON b.base=d.name JOIN shared_classes c ON c.__path=b.__path AND c.id=b.id) SELECT * FROM derived

stages.name: method_nodes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,m.id method,m.class_event,m.name method_name,m.class_name FROM a n JOIN functions owner ON owner.__path=n.__path AND owner.id=n.fn JOIN classes lexical ON lexical.__path=n.__path AND lexical.id=n.cls JOIN method_events m ON m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_name=lexical.name JOIN shared_classes final_class ON final_class.__path=m.__path AND final_class.id=m.class_event AND m.name=owner.name WHERE m.id<=n.id AND m.class_event=(SELECT max(c.id) FROM class_events c WHERE c.__path=n.__path AND c.name=lexical.name AND c.id<=n.id) AND m.id=(SELECT max(prior.id) FROM method_events prior WHERE prior.__path=n.__path AND prior.class_event=m.class_event AND prior.name=m.name AND prior.id<=n.id)

stages.name: type_error_raises
stages.query: SELECT r.__path,r.id FROM a r JOIN a exc ON exc.__path=r.__path AND exc.parent=r.id AND exc.field='exc' JOIN local_names q ON q.__path=exc.__path AND q.id=exc.id WHERE r.kind='Raise' AND q.name='TypeError'

stages.name: contract_blocks
stages.query: SELECT block.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY block.__path ORDER BY block.last-block.id,block.id DESC,block.role) sequence FROM (SELECT owner.__path,owner.id,owner.last,child.field role FROM a owner JOIN a child ON child.__path=owner.__path AND child.parent=owner.id WHERE owner.kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef','If','match_case') AND child.field IN ('body','orelse') GROUP BY owner.__path,owner.id,child.field) block

stages.name: block_results
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE fold(__path,sequence,state) AS (SELECT DISTINCT __path,0,'{}' FROM contract_blocks UNION ALL SELECT b.__path,b.sequence,substr(fold.state,1,length(fold.state)-1)||CASE WHEN length(fold.state)>2 THEN ',' ELSE '' END||json_quote(CAST(b.id AS TEXT)||':'||b.role)||':'||CAST((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a stmt WHERE stmt.__path=b.__path AND stmt.parent=b.id AND stmt.field=b.role AND stmt.position<=coalesce((SELECT min(barrier.position) FROM a barrier WHERE barrier.__path=b.__path AND barrier.parent=b.id AND barrier.field=b.role AND barrier.kind IN ('Raise','Return','Yield','YieldFrom')),2147483647) AND (stmt.kind='Raise' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM type_error_raises r WHERE r.__path=stmt.__path AND r.id=stmt.id) OR stmt.kind='If' AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||stmt.id||':body"'),0)=1 AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||stmt.id||':orelse"'),0)=1 OR stmt.kind='Match' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a arm WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.parent=stmt.id AND arm.field='cases') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a arm WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.parent=stmt.id AND arm.field='cases' AND NOT (coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||arm.id||':body"'),0)=1))))) AS TEXT)||'}' FROM fold JOIN contract_blocks b ON b.__path=fold.__path AND b.sequence=fold.sequence+1) SELECT __path,state FROM fold WHERE sequence=(SELECT max(b.sequence) FROM contract_blocks b WHERE b.__path=fold.__path)

stages.name: method_colors
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.id,coalesce(json_extract(b.state,'$."'||m.id||':body"'),0) always_raises,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_nodes n JOIN type_error_raises r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.id WHERE n.__path=m.__path AND n.method=m.id) raises_type_error,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a n WHERE n.__path=m.__path AND n.id BETWEEN m.id AND m.last AND n.kind='Name' AND n.name='BackendType') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a n WHERE n.__path=m.__path AND n.id BETWEEN m.id AND m.last AND n.kind='Attribute' AND n.name IN ('backend_type','is_sql_backend','dialect')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a n WHERE n.__path=m.__path AND n.id BETWEEN m.id AND m.last AND n.kind IN ('If','IfExp','Match')) backend_selection FROM shared_methods m LEFT JOIN block_results b ON b.__path=m.__path

stages.name: method_returns
stages.query: SELECT n.*,value.kind expression_kind,value.value value_text,q.name dotted FROM method_nodes n JOIN a value ON value.__path=n.__path AND value.parent=n.id AND value.field='value' LEFT JOIN local_names q ON q.__path=value.__path AND q.id=value.id WHERE n.kind='Return'

stages.name: shared_calls
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.method,n.id,n.line,q.name FROM method_nodes n JOIN calls call ON call.__path=n.__path AND call.id=n.id LEFT JOIN context_names q ON q.__path=call.__path AND q.id=call.callee_id WHERE n.kind='Call'

stages.name: callable_parameters
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.__path,m.id method,p.name FROM shared_methods m JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=m.__path AND p.fn=m.id JOIN a name ON name.__path=p.__path AND name.id BETWEEN p.id AND p.last AND name.kind='Name' AND name.name='Callable'

stages.name: branch_names
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE targets(__path,method,event,id) AS (SELECT loop.__path,loop.method,loop.id,target.id FROM method_nodes loop JOIN a iter ON iter.__path=loop.__path AND iter.parent=loop.id AND iter.field='iter' JOIN local_names q ON q.__path=iter.__path AND q.id=iter.id JOIN a target ON target.__path=loop.__path AND target.parent=loop.id AND target.field='target' WHERE loop.kind='For' AND rx_matches(q.name,'then_plan\.steps|else_plan\.steps|conditional_branch_steps|then_steps|else_steps') UNION ALL SELECT t.__path,t.method,t.event,child.id FROM targets t JOIN a parent ON parent.__path=t.__path AND parent.id=t.id AND parent.kind IN ('Tuple','List') JOIN a child ON child.__path=parent.__path AND child.parent=parent.id AND child.field='elts') SELECT t.__path,t.method,t.event,n.name FROM targets t JOIN a n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.id=t.id AND n.kind='Name'

stages.name: method_backend_controls
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM method_nodes n JOIN a test ON test.__path=n.__path AND test.parent=n.id AND test.field IN ('test','subject') JOIN a attr ON attr.__path=test.__path AND attr.id BETWEEN test.id AND test.last AND attr.kind='Attribute' AND attr.name IN ('backend_type','is_sql_backend') WHERE n.kind IN ('If','IfExp','Match') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a nested JOIN a predicate ON predicate.__path=nested.__path AND predicate.parent=nested.id AND predicate.field IN ('test','subject') WHERE nested.__path=test.__path AND nested.id BETWEEN test.id AND test.last AND nested.kind IN ('If','IfExp','Match') AND attr.id BETWEEN predicate.id AND predicate.last) GROUP BY n.__path,n.id

stages.name: conditional_findings_0
stages.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'semantic ConditionalStep must reject direct compilation with TypeError' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'semantic-compile' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE n.qualified_name='l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='compile' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_colors color WHERE color.__path=m.__path AND color.id=m.id AND color.raises_type_error))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'semantic ConditionalStep lowering level must require physical lowering' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'semantic-level' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE n.qualified_name='l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='level' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_returns r WHERE r.__path=m.__path AND r.method=m.id AND r.expression_kind='Constant' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a v WHERE v.__path=r.__path AND v.parent=r.id AND v.field='value' AND v.value_kind IN ('int','bool'))))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='level' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_returns r WHERE r.__path=m.__path AND r.method=m.id AND r.expression_kind='Constant' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a v WHERE v.__path=r.__path AND v.parent=r.id AND v.field='value' AND v.value_kind IN ('int','bool')) AND CASE r.value_text WHEN 'True' THEN 1 WHEN 'False' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(r.value_text AS INTEGER) END<=0)))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'SqlBackendExecutor must define _lower_conditional_step' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'executor-hook' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='_lower_conditional_step' AND (1)) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'SqlConditionalStep must be terminal at lowering level zero' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'physical-level' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep' AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='level' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM method_returns r WHERE r.__path=m.__path AND r.method=m.id AND r.expression_kind='Constant' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a v WHERE v.__path=r.__path AND v.parent=r.id AND v.field='value' AND v.value_kind IN ('int','bool')))=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_returns r WHERE r.__path=m.__path AND r.method=m.id AND r.expression_kind='Constant' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a v WHERE v.__path=r.__path AND v.parent=r.id AND v.field='value' AND v.value_kind IN ('int','bool')) AND (r.value_text='False' OR r.value_text='0')))))

stages.name: conditional_findings_1
stages.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'SqlConditionalStep must have the SQL execution role' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'physical-role' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='execution_role' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_returns r WHERE r.__path=m.__path AND r.method=m.id AND r.dotted='StepExecutionRole.SQL'))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'SqlConditionalStep.compile must delegate to the approved physical compiler' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'physical-compile' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='compile' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_calls call WHERE call.__path=m.__path AND call.method=m.id AND (substr(call.name,-28)='compile_sql_conditional_step')))) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'semantic typed conditional contract must unconditionally reject with TypeError' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'semantic-contract' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE n.qualified_name='l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='require_sql_physical_conditional' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM method_colors color WHERE color.__path=m.__path AND color.id=m.id AND color.always_raises)))) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_classes WHERE qualified_name IN ('impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor','impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep','l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_functions WHERE qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._conditional_compile.compile_sql_conditional_step')) UNION ALL SELECT 'l2070_batching/conditional_step.py' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,1 line,'CONDA-005' issue,'semantic typed conditional contract must unconditionally reject with TypeError' message,'missing' identity,0 phase,0 ordering,'' symbol,'' sort_name,'semantic-contract' detector WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_classes WHERE qualified_name IN ('impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor','impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep','l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_functions WHERE qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._conditional_compile.compile_sql_conditional_step')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_classes WHERE qualified_name='l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep')

stages.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'physical typed conditional contract must override semantic rejection without backend selection' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'physical-contract' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE selection' message,'missing' identity,0 phase,0 ordering,'' symbol,'' sort_name,'physical-contract' detector WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_classes WHERE qualified_name IN qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'lowering typed conditional contract must produce SqlConditionalStep from the semantic conditional' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'lowering-contract' detector FROM shared_classes n WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_methods m WHERE m.__path=n.__path AND m.class_event=n.id AND m.name='_lower_conditional_step' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_calls call WHERE call.__path=m.__path AND call.method=m.id AND (substr(call.name,-32)='SqlConditionalStep.from_semantic'))))) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_classes WHERE qualified_name IN ('impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor','impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep','l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep')) OR 'impl/common/l2070_server_plan/sql_backend_executor.py' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,1 line,'CONDA-005' issue,'lowering typed conditional contract must produce SqlConditionalStep from the semantic conditional' message,'missing' identity,0 phase,0 ordering,'' symbol,'' sort_name,'lowering-contract' detector WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_classes WHERE qualified_name IN ('impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor','impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep','l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_functions WHERE qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._conditional_compile.compile_sql_conditional_step')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_classes WHERE qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor')

stages.name: conditional_findings_3
stages.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'CONDA-005' AS issue,'compiler typed conditional contract must validate its SqlConditionalStep before strategy selection' AS message,n.id||':CONDA-005:'||(n.id) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.id AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name,'compiler-contract' detector FROM shared_functions n WHERE n.qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._conditional_compile.compile_sql_conditional_step' AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parameters p JOIN a ann ON ann.__path=p.__path AND ann.parent=p.id AND ann.field='annotation' JOIN local_names q ON q.__path=ann.__path AND q.id=ann.id WHERE p.__path=n.__path AND p.fn=n.id AND p.name='step' AND p.field IN ('posonlyargs','args','kwonlyargs') AND coalesce((SELECT alias.origin FROM shared_aliases alias WHERE alias.__path=n.__path AND alias.local=rx_extract(q.name,'^([^.]+)',1) AND alias.id<n.id ORDER BY alias.id DESC LIMIT 1),rx_extract(q.name,'^([^.]+)',1))||coalesce(rx_extract(q.name,'^[^.]+([.].*)$',1),'')='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep') AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a attr WHERE attr.__path=n.__path AND attr.id BETWEEN n.id AND n.last AND (attr.kind='Name' AND attr.name='BackendType')) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a attr WHERE attr.__path=n.__path AND attr.id BETWEEN n.id AND n.last AND (attr.kind='Attribute' AND attr.name IN ('backend_type','is_sql_backend','dialect'))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM a control WHERE control.__path=n.__path AND control.id BETWEEN n.id AND n.last AND (control.kind IN ('If','IfExp','Match'))))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls call JOIN local_names q ON q.__path=call.__path AND q.id=call.callee_id WHERE call.__path=n.__path AND call.id BETWEEN n.id AND n.last AND q.name='step.require_sql_physical_conditional' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls strategy JOIN local_names sq ON sq.__path=strategy.__path AND sq.id=strategy.callee_id WHERE strategy.__path=n.__path AND strategy.id BETWEEN n.id AND n.last AND substr(sq.name,-21)='_conditional_strategy' AND strategy.line<=call.line))) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_classes WHERE qualified_name IN ('impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_backend_executor.SqlBackendExecutor','impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_conditional.SqlConditionalStep','l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shared_functions WHERE qualified_name='impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._conditional_compile.compile_sql_conditional_step')) UNION ALL SELECT 'impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/_conditional_compile.py' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,1 line,'CONDA-005' issue,'compiler typed conditional contract must validate its SqlConditionalStep before
